prompt: Explain TTFT and TPOT. A request emits its first token at 200 ms and its last token at 1200 ms after the request starts, with 21 output tokens in total. Calculate TTFT, average TPOT, and decode tokens/second. Show the formulas briefly.

## 1. Definitions

### TTFT (Time to First Token)
**TTFT** measures the time elapsed from when a request is sent until the *very first* token of the response is received. It is a key metric for measuring the initial responsiveness of a system.

**Formula:**
$$\text{TTFT} = \text{Time of First Token Received} - \text{Request Start Time}$$

### TPOT (Time Per Output Token)
**TPOT** measures the average time taken to generate or receive a single output token over the entire duration of the response. It is a measure of the sustained throughput or latency per token.

**Formula:**
$$\text{Average TPOT} = \frac{\text{Total Response Time}}{\text{Total Number of Output Tokens}}$$
